title: Numbers 19:3 — the red heifer was to be sacrificed outside the camp
summary: Numbers 19:3 in English (Eleazar and 'it' picked out in colour): the heifer is given to Eleazar the priest, brought outside the camp and slaughtered in his presence. A large caption states that the Red Heifer was to be sacrificed outside the camp.

text.text: 3 ‘You shall give it to Eleazar the priest, and it shall be brought outside the camp and be slaughtered in his presence.
The Red Heifer was to be sacrificed outside the camp.
